title: test(plugin-dashboard): a dimension-less KPI tile re-reads on the data-invalidation bus once its answer names the base object (objectui#11095)
body:
Fixes #11095

Clause-②: no

## What this is

Triage's ruling on the card (`5890740102`) set the unlock work: re-measure the four KPI tiles in a running console against a backend that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#20644, add a `DatasetWidget` pin, and close the card with the measurement if objectui then needs no code change. It needs none. This PR is the pin, an empty-frontmatter changeset and one doc comment, and no executable code changes.

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.kpiInvalidation-11095.test.tsx` has four cases on the page path: the real `SchemaRenderer`, this package's own registration, and a bare `useDataInvalidation` reader as the positive control. The fake answers the shape the producer returns for `dimensions: []`: `rows`, `fields` and `object`, with no `dimensionFields` and no `drillRawRows`.
  1. A write to the answer's object re-reads a `metric` tile with no dimensions once, in place (the same value node). A write to another object does not re-read it.
  2. The unscoped change the console's timer and Refresh All declare (`objectName: '*'`) re-reads it.
  3. A zero-row first answer that names the object subscribes too.
  4. An answer that names no object subscribes to nothing. This is the ruling's "no consumer-side fallback": no `'*'` subscription and no read of the dataset's metadata.
- `.changeset/11095-kpi-tile-invalidation-pin.md` has empty frontmatter: tests and one doc comment, no behaviour change. Its body says the comment ships in `dist` JS. AGENTS.md §9 asks a change with no behaviour, export or type change for a declaration, not a release.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.tsx`: the `refreshDashboardData` doc comment only, added in patch round 1 (seat comment `5986840462`). Its paragraph said the server names the base object only beside drill-through metadata, so a dataset-bound KPI tile never re-reads on this handler or on a declared write. Closing this card makes that false on the record, and the live re-measure below measured it false on objectstack `e83c9f61`. The paragraph now says every dataset answer names the object, and points at the pin and the upstream producer pin. The `'*'` scope paragraph and every other sentence are unchanged. `@object-ui/app-shell` builds with `tsc`, so the comment ships in the published `dist/views/DashboardView.js`: the published 17.7.0 tarball carries the old sentence once. No `.d.ts` carries it, because the function is not exported.

The producer half is pinned upstream by `service-analytics`'s `dataset-answer-object.test.ts`.

## Live re-measure

- **Backend:** objectstack `main` at `e83c9f61`, in its own worktree, showcase closure built (turbo, 60/60 tasks), run with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a temporary database.
- **Console:** this branch's `apps/console` dev server, proxied to that backend.
- **Browser:** Playwright Chromium on `/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard`, logging every `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with the `object` its answer named.

**The wire** (curl, `datasetName: showcase_project_metrics` unless noted):

| selection | rows | `object` |
|---|---|---|
| `dimensions: []`, filter `health: red` | 1 | `showcase_project` |
| `dimensions: []`, a filter matching nothing (an ungrouped COUNT answers one row of 0) | 1 | `showcase_project` |
| `dimensions: ['health']`, a filter matching nothing | 0 | `showcase_project` |
| `dimensions: []` on `showcase_task_metrics` | 1 | `showcase_task` |

The card's original reading answered no `object` for `dimensions: []`.

**The four KPI tiles** (Active Projects, At-Risk (Red), Awaiting Review, Total Budget):

- **Initial load:** each of the four dimension-less queries answered `object` (`showcase_project` three times, `showcase_task` once).
- **Out-of-band REST create of a red project, then 12 s idle with no timer authored:** 0 queries, and At-Risk stays at 1. This is expected, because the bus never hears an out-of-band write.
- **Refresh All:** 9 queries, 4 of them the KPI tiles. At-Risk went from 1 to 2 on the same DOM node I marked before the click, so the re-read was in place.
- **A change scoped to `showcase_task`:** 4 queries, the Awaiting Review tile and the three task charts. The three project KPI tiles did not re-read. Awaiting Review went from 2 to 3 after an out-of-band in-review task. The event was emitted through the app's own `notifyDataChanged` module as a stand-in for a declared write; this page has no real write path.
- **Timer:** `refreshIntervalSeconds: 10` was injected into the served dashboard metadata in the browser only (route interception; the backend was untouched). After an out-of-band red project and about 27 s with no interaction: 2 periods 10 s apart, 9 queries each, including all four KPI tiles. At-Risk went from 2 to 3 after the first period.

## Ablation: the pin can fail

The script carried its own `EXIT INT TERM` trap. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved), and each restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty. Both runs covered the new file and the objectui#10815 pin.

| mutation of `DatasetWidget.tsx` | new pin | objectui#10815 pin |
|---|---|---|
| subscribe only when the answer also carries `dimensionFields` | 3 failed (cases 1 to 3), case 4 green | 5/5 green |
| a `'*'` fallback key when the answer names no object | case 4 failed, 1 to 3 green | 5/5 green |

The first row is the gap: the objectui#10815 pin's answers always carry drill metadata, so it could not see a dimension-less tile.

## Tests, patch round 1 (at `17d39ad`)

- Merge commit `45f7b2c` brings in `origin/main` at `1c2e2c4`.
- The edit is comment-only, measured: TypeScript's scanner, with comments skipped, gives the same 970 tokens for `main`'s copy of `DashboardView.tsx` and this one, while the bytes differ.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` exits 0 (0 errors). `DashboardView.tsx` alone: 0 errors and 9 warnings, the same 9 as `main`'s copy of the file (linted through stdin).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0, after building its dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, 28/28). Run through the shared verify lock.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new pin and the objectui#10815 pin: 2 files, 9 passed.
- These exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (2 source files in 2 released packages, 1 empty-frontmatter changeset) and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.

## Tests, round 0 (at `a36c241`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`: 169 files passed, 1673 passed, 6 skipped. Run through the shared verify lock.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` exits 0, after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...`, 12/12). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new file once.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard lint` exits 0 (0 errors). The new file itself: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- These root gates all exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- At round 0, `origin/main` still equalled the branch's base `9dfaca6`, so no merge commit was possible then. Patch round 1 merged `1c2e2c4` (above).

## Acceptance notes

- One prose site still restates the pre-17.6.0 contract. `ObjectStackAdapter.queryDataset` in `packages/data-objectstack` declares `object?: string` locally, and its doc calls `object` drill metadata "the REST route adds on top of `AnalyticsResult`". Since `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0, `object` is a declared `AnalyticsResult` member. The types agree, so nothing misbehaves; it is a restated contract that could drift. It is not touched here; carrier: none named. The other site, the `DashboardView.tsx` comment, is fixed in this PR (patch round 1).
- On initial load the console issued each widget's dataset query twice (18 queries for 9 widgets), about 0.1 s apart, in the dev server. I did not investigate this; a dev-mode double effect is a plausible reading, not a measured one.
